title: Penis Disorders
summary: Problems with the penis can cause pain and affect a man's sexual function and fertility. Penis disorders include: Erectile dysfunction - inability to get or keep an erection Priapism - a painful erection that does not go away Peyronie's disease - bending of the penis during an erection due to a hard lump called a plaque Balanitis - inflammation of the skin covering the head of the penis, most often in men and boys who have not been circumcised Penile cancer - a rare form of cancer, highly curable when caught early
treatment: Treatment depends on the cause of the balanitis. Antibiotic pills or creams are used to treat balanitis that is caused by bacteria. Steroid creams may help balanitis that occurs with skin diseases. Anti-fungal cream will be prescribed if it is due to a fungus. In severe cases, circumcision may be the best option. If you cannot pull back (retract) the foreskin to clean it, you may need to be circumcised.
source: MedlinePlus, U.S. National Library of Medicine
